draft.text: "From Token to Fleet" details the engineering principles and systems required to scale LLM inference from single-token processing to multi-GPU fleet deployment. It covers architectures, optimization techniques, and operational considerations observed in production environments. This book serves as a practical reference for engineers implementing and managing large-scale LLM infrastructure.
